text:
zira: quick heads up — JS SDK release blocked by semver-check. regen diff only shows optional prop -> union with undefined, but semver tool treats that as a surface change so auto-release flipped to minor.
ci-bot: build #5102 failed at publish step: https://ci.example.com/5102 (exit 1)
cole: pasted minimal diff from generated types:```diff
- export interface Feature { enabled?: boolean }
+ export interface Feature { enabled: boolean | undefined }
```
typegen v3.5.2 started emitting explicit unions instead of `?` for optional props after a dependency bump.
anika: also seeing onboarding e2e flakes in sample-app tests: retry middleware increments a `retryAttempts` field on the request body in-place, so second attempt has a different payload and equality asserts fail intermittently, which stalls the gated publish.
ghazal: immediate mitigation thoughts: (1) normalization pass before semver-check to canonicalize optional syntax (map `T | undefined` -> `T?` for comparison), (2) CI regen-gate that labels PRs with only `generated/` changes as `regen-only` and prevent auto-minor, (3) test harness fix to deep-clone request bodies before retry so retries are idempotent.
zira: agree. we should also pin the typegen dependency in the release branch short-term so we can unstick the publish while fixes land.
cole: repro steps: `git checkout release && ./scripts/regenerate && git --no-pager diff generated/` shows `clients/*.ts` changes. locally `./tools/typegen --prefer-optional-syntax` recreates old `?` style. i'll open a PR to add a `--prefer-optional-syntax` flag and enable as default in our fork.
anika: i'll add the deep-clone in tests: `const bodyCopy = structuredClone(req.body)` before retry and update equality helpers to ignore `retryAttempts` if present. small test-only PR.
ghazal: i'll implement a tiny normalize script `tools/normalize-optional-syntax.js` used by `release/semver-check` that rewrites `T | undefined` -> `T?` in generated outputs for the diff step. semver-bot can run on the normalized tree.
semver-bot: created note: will accept normalization hooks at `release/semver-check` if present.
devex-bot: created issue #1488 "typegen union-undefined regen triggers minor + retry mutation flakes" and attached CI job 5102.
cole: i'll also add CI check `git diff --exit-code generated/ || echo "regen-diff"` and have the publish job require manual approval when `regen-diff` present.
zira: owners: A) pin typegen in release CI (owner: zira), B) normalize for semver (owner: ghazal), C) test harness clone (owner: anika), D) typegen default flag PR (owner: cole).
anika: assigned C and will open PR with tests.
ghazal: assigned B, will add unit tests for normalize script.
cole: assigned D, will open PR to add `--prefer-optional-syntax` + test and coordinate unpin.
zira: i'll pin typegen in release job and run a canary publish after PRs land. leaving a note in the release runbook with owners and rollback steps. thanks all :+1:
ci-bot: rerun queued: job #5103 started by cole (reproduce).
semver-bot: once normalization script present, semver-check will re-run and classify regen-only diffs as patch-level unless manual changelog present.
zira: short timeline: PRs for B/C/D by EOD, unpin and canary tomorrow morning. closing loop after canary.
